name: com.qrpainter/qrpainter
title: QRPainter
description: Turn pictures into editable QR codes, test how well they scan, and export them for print.

tools.name: create_qr_from_image
tools.description: Turn a logo or picture into a QR code that looks like the picture and is verified to scan (multi-decoder Scan Lab). The link is editable later. Returns the code image, its short link, Scan Score and an edit key. Free codes show a 2-second branded page before redirecting.

image_url.description: Public http(s) URL of a logo or picture (PNG/JPG/WebP).

image_base64.description: Base64-encoded picture, as an alternative to image_url.

style.description: pixel = picture drawn with QR squares; halftone = picture in fine dots; halftone-color keeps the picture's colours.

grid.description: Modules across. Bigger grid = more picture detail, needs a larger print.

allow_low_score.description: Explicit acknowledgement that a score below 70 needs your own printed-device testing.

tools.name: preview_styles
tools.description: Generate 4 scored variants of a picture QR without saving. Use save_design to keep one.

image_url.description: Public http(s) URL of a logo or picture (PNG/JPG/WebP).

image_base64.description: Base64-encoded picture, as an alternative to image_url.

style.description: pixel = picture drawn with QR squares; halftone = picture in fine dots; halftone-color keeps the picture's colours.

grid.description: Modules across. Bigger grid = more picture detail, needs a larger print.

tools.name: save_design
tools.description: Save a variant from preview_styles as a live code pointing at destination.

allow_low_score.description: Explicit acknowledgement that a score below 70 needs your own printed-device testing.

tools.name: check_scan_score
tools.description: Test any QR code image under 11 simulated conditions with 3 independent decoders; returns a 0-100 Scan Score and what failed.

image_url.description: Public http(s) URL of a logo or picture (PNG/JPG/WebP).

image_base64.description: Base64-encoded picture, as an alternative to image_url.

tools.name: update_destination
tools.description: Change where an existing code leads. The printed code stays the same.

edit_key.description: Returned when the code was created.

tools.name: get_scans
tools.description: Scan counts by day, hour and country for a code (temporary salted visitor hashes are retained for recent unique counts).

edit_key.description: Returned when the code was created.

tools.name: export
tools.description: Export a code as SVG (vector, one path per colour) or PNG at a given pixel size.

edit_key.description: Returned when the code was created.
